svg.title: Conceptual ER model, contract 1.0.0
svg.text: HDB resale and hawker centres - conceptual ER model
Chen notation with (min,max) participation | contract 1.0.0 | no tables or foreign keys at this level; mapping in task1_report.md
HDB FLAT alternate key: its HDB BUILDING + all six profile attributes
on an entity-relationship line: how many
instances of that relationship ONE entity
instance takes part in; N = many.
on an attribute line: optional attribute.
IS NEAR links a building to a hawker
A flat takes part in exactly one IN BUILDING
(1,1), so its proximity is its building's.
